name: Sanctions & coercion
value: US blockade of Iran; Graham Act in force
summary: US blockade of Iran and new secondary-sanction powers on Russia
state: The US naval blockade of Iranian ports remains in force; on 31 Oct Iran set the lifting of sanctions imposed after the Islamabad memorandum and release of frozen funds as conditions in Doha talks. The Lindsey Graham Act, signed in October, expands secondary sanctions on Russia's trading partners. No new major package was announced to 1 Nov.
for_you: Sanctions are reshaping energy trade routes and can affect prices and supply far from the targeted countries.
